title: DIGISEQ-DT2
author: Robbie (DIGISEQ for Digitakt); Digitakt II 1.17 port
description: DIGISEQ for the Digitakt II, OS 1.17: sequencer types a track plays in place of its own trigs, chosen per track (TYPE: OFF, SNAKE, 185 or ARP), on all 16 tracks, audio and MIDI. SNAKE: a Cartesian sequencer after MDD Snake (and Make Noise's Rene), eight cells in a 4 x 2 grid walked by a path. 185: a stage sequencer after ML-185 (and RYK's M-185): eight stages, each with a pitch, a velocity, a length of 1-8 clock pulses and a mode (OFF, ONE, ALL every DIV pulses, HOLD for the whole stage). ARP (0.3): an arpeggiator played by the track's note trigs, held for the trig's LEN (INF or HOLD: until the next trig): MODE (UP, DOWN, UP-DN, UP+DN, CONV, DIV, PINKY, THUMB, ORDER, RAND, SHUF), SPD (1/16 .. 1/1), RNG (1-4 octaves), SCALE (CHR or 11 scales, rooted on NOTE), RPT, WALK (0 brings it back), HOLD and a 16-step OFFSETS sequence. Ported from Robbie's DIGISEQ for Digitakt 0.8 (ARP from 0.3, 0.6 and 0.7); replaces DIGISNAKE-DT2. Press TRIG on the TRIG page until its pages come round to open it; hold TRIG + UP / DOWN changes TYPE. Not on the Digitakt II yet: PRINT, CLOCK 2X, ARP from the keyboard, live recording, the stock drop-down messages; a trig's note locks and a MIDI chord's other notes do not reach ARP yet (it takes the track's NOTE). Not saved with the project. Experimental.
